title: Fix Silent JSON Parse Errors in combineApiRequests
author: zwbproducts
lessons: Always verify the diff matches the PR description -- excellent writeup can mask a fundamentally broken implementation
Re-export wrappers (src/shared/) hide the real code in packages/core/ -- contributors unfamiliar with the monorepo structure may edit the wrong file
Bundling unrelated changes (JSON parse logging + safeWriteJson retry + ClineProvider retry) makes each individual change impossible to evaluate
Silent retries mask root causes -- adding retry loops on top of existing retry/error-handling mechanisms creates nested complexity

test_results.reason: Tests assert console.warn calls that were never added to the implementation

blocking_issues: Core fix never applied -- consolidateApiRequests.ts in packages/core/ was not modified
Export removed from src/shared/combineApiRequests.ts -- breaks the module
New tests assert non-existent behavior (console.warn) -- will fail
3 unrelated changes bundled: safeWriteJson rewrite, ClineProvider retry, root-level docs
3 root-level markdown files (BUGFIX.md, PR_FORK.md, PR_UPSTREAM.md) do not belong in the repo
